goal: Make database read and deserialization errors consistently fatal instead of masking corruption
Prevent corrupted database records from masquerading as missing inputs or crashing unexpectedly
Simplify coin view error handling for maintainers
agreement: Disputed with an open blocking objection despite engagement (ajtowns)
Unaddressed objection: aborting the entire node on optional index corruption is too severe (ajtowns)
Support for removing the indirection layer to reduce view stack complexity (andrewtoth)
Resolved objection: continuing execution on deserialization failure settled by fatal aborts (maflcko)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it prevents storage corruption from masquerading as missing UTXOs
Avoids unhandled exceptions during database reads and removes redundant view wrapping logic
